description: Turnip Vulkan driver package from The412Banner/Banners-Turnip, upstream release v27.0.0-20261105-r6. Standard A6xx/A7xx driver with the Adreno 740 (Snapdragon 8 Gen 2) UBWC flag hint turned on, to match newer system drivers such as Samsung One UI and stop UI glitches and flicker. Only for 8 Gen 2 devices on newer firmware; on others it causes the glitch. All other GPUs unaffected. Package declares Android API 28 or newer. OneUI-specific workaround; use only for the device/UI issue described upstream. Automated Mesa build; runtime compatibility is not established for every device or game. GPU model, kernel and emulator compatibility still depend on the upstream release; not a universal replacement for all Adreno devices.

name: Turnip-v27.0.0-20261101-r4-8G2-OneUI (The412Banner)

name: Turnip-v27.0.0-20261028-r2-8G2-OneUI (The412Banner)
gpu: Adreno 740 (Snapdragon 8 Gen 2 / OneUI-specific build)
description: Turnip Vulkan driver package from The412Banner/Banners-Turnip, upstream release v27.0.0-20261028-r2. Standard A6xx/A7xx driver with the Adreno 740 (Snapdragon 8 Gen 2) UBWC flag hint turned on, to match newer system drivers such as Samsung One UI and stop UI glitches and flicker. Only for 8 Gen 2 devices on newer firmware; on others it causes the glitch. All other GPUs unaffected. Package declares Android API 28 or newer. OneUI-specific workaround; use only for the device/UI issue described upstream. Automated Mesa build; runtime compatibility is not established for every device or game. GPU model, kernel and emulator compatibility still depend on the upstream release; not a universal replacement for all Adreno devices.

GPU model, kernel and emulator compatibility still depend on the upstream release; not a universal replacement for all Adreno devices.

description: Turnip Vulkan driver package from The412Banner/Banners-Turnip, upstream release v26.3.0-20260818-r15. name: MaliSX2 0.4.1

description: MaliSX2 Vulkan driver by ARMSX2 and bmdhacks for supported Mali GPUs. 0.4.1 adds Vita3K-Plus support and its memory mapping modes, fixes broken geometry in God of War Collection on the Mali-G52, and rejects stale shaders that could cause an out-of-memory crash after changing Vita3K settings. Vita3K-Plus gameplay has only been tested upstream on the Mali-G52; the required driver features passed tests on the Mali-G57 and G615, but gameplay there is not yet tested. ARMSX2 output is unchanged across the 22-dump accuracy corpus on the Mali-G57 and G615, with no slowdown found. The pipeline cache is rebuilt once after the update because the version is part of driverInfo. G52 / G52 r1 support is experimental and Mali-G76 is untested by the upstream authors. G57/G68/G77/G78/G78AE require kbase r40p0 or newer (kernel interface 11.36+). G615/G715 are supported. MSAA is not implemented and is reported as 1x, so an app that assumes 4x multisampling may not start. Other Mali generations are unsupported. Requires Android 10 (API 29) or newer. Device firmware and kernel compatibility still apply.

name: MaliSX2 0.4.0
gpu: Mali Bifrost/Valhall (G52, G52 r1, G76, G57, G68, G77, G78, G78AE, G615, G715)
description: MaliSX2 Vulkan driver by ARMSX2 and bmdhacks for supported Mali GPUs. 0.4.0 adds synchronization2 barriers and submits, more dynamic pipeline state, local read, descriptor indexing, 8- and 16-bit numbers in shaders, events and indirect draws/dispatches on every supported GPU, so more apps and emulators can run. It also brings parallel-RDP (mupen64plus-next) and BC compressed textures to the Mali-G52 and the G57 family, fixes Mali-G52 device loss in Persona 4, GPU hangs on Unisoc T618 devices and instanced draws that start part-way through a vertex buffer, and stops apps crashing on indirect draws and dispatches. ARMSX2 output and frame times are unchanged, but the pipeline cache is rebuilt once after the update because the version is part of driverInfo; MALISX2_DEBUG was replaced by MALISX2_MEASURE=cpuprof. G52 / G52 r1 support is experimental and Mali-G76 is untested upstream. G57/G68/G77/G78/G78AE require kbase r40p0 or newer (kernel interface 11.36+). G615/G715 are tested. MSAA is still reported as 1x, so an app that assumes 4x multisampling may not start. Other Mali generations are unsupported. Requires Android 10 (API 29) or newer. Device firmware and kernel compatibility still apply.

name: MaliSX2 0.3.3
gpu: Mali Bifrost/Valhall (G52, G52 r1, G76, G57, G68, G77, G78, G78AE, G615, G715)
description: MaliSX2 Vulkan driver by ARMSX2 and bmdhacks for supported Mali GPUs. 0.3.3 fixes crashes on the Mali-G52 at 1.5x internal resolution and above by letting the tiler memory grow as far as the scene needs instead of failing with "Host GPU device encountered an error and was recovered", and removes the thin vertical streaks at 2x and higher on the Mali-G615 and the G57 family (WRC 3, Katamari Damacy) caused by reordering triangles in draws that read back the picture they draw on. ARMSX2 output and frame times are unchanged, but the pipeline cache is rebuilt once after the update because the version is part of driverInfo. G52 / G52 r1 support is experimental and Mali-G76 is untested upstream. G57/G68/G77/G78/G78AE require kbase r40p0 or newer (kernel interface 11.36+). G615/G715 are tested. MSAA is still reported as 1x, so an app that assumes 4x multisampling may not start. Other Mali generations are unsupported. Requires Android 10 (API 29) or newer. Device firmware and kernel compatibility still apply.

name: MaliSX2 0.3.2
gpu: Mali Bifrost/Valhall (G52, G52 r1, G76, G57, G68, G77, G78, G78AE, G615, G715)
description: MaliSX2 Vulkan driver by ARMSX2 and bmdhacks for supported Mali GPUs. 0.3.2 is mostly hakuX work on the Mali-G52: the tiler memory ring now grows from 4 to as many as 16 regions only when a game keeps running out (Xenosaga at 3x is about 10% faster on the Mali-G57), Android graphics buffers can be imported as Vulkan buffers, descriptor pools without the free flag hand out sets from a cheaper bump allocator, the new vkCmdSetIndexRangeMALISX2 command skips the CPU index-range scan on the G52 and G76, and MALISX2_DEBUG adds CPU time, GPU cycle and shader statistics. ARMSX2 output and frame times are unchanged, but the pipeline cache is rebuilt once after the update because the version is part of driverInfo. G52 / G52 r1 support is experimental and Mali-G76 is untested upstream. G57/G68/G77/G78/G78AE require kbase r40p0 or newer (kernel interface 11.36+). G615/G715 are tested. MSAA is still reported as 1x, so an app that assumes 4x multisampling may not start. Other Mali generations are unsupported. Requires Android 10 (API 29) or newer. Device firmware and kernel compatibility still apply.

name: MaliSX2 0.3.1
gpu: Mali Bifrost/Valhall (G52, G52 r1, G57, G68, G76, G77, G78, G78AE, G615, G715)
description: MaliSX2 Vulkan driver by ARMSX2 and bmdhacks for supported Mali GPUs. 0.3.1 implements occlusion queries on all three GPU families, so Dolphin's Vulkan backend now opens; adds VkEvent, query pools and clip distances on the Mali-G615, skips provably invisible early depth tests, accepts the Mali-G76 on the Bifrost path, and ships a newer shader compiler that is a few percent faster on Dolphin. hakuX on the Mali-G615 is about 1.7x faster at 3x/4x internal resolution and about a third faster at 1x on the Mali-G57, with an unchanged picture. ARMSX2 behaviour is unchanged, but the pipeline cache is rebuilt once after the update because the version is part of driverInfo. MSAA is still reported as 1x only. G52 / G52 r1 are experimental and G76 is untested by the upstream authors. G57/G68/G77/G78/G78AE require kbase r40p0 or newer (kernel interface 11.36+). G615/G715 are tested. Other Mali generations are unsupported. Requires Android 10 (API 29) or newer. Device firmware and kernel compatibility still apply.
